g.text: Add New Bot - Concrete Integration Checklist
constructor args must match BOT_SPEC params values
bot constructor and passes only accepted names.
It always builds RewardSystem with MazeSensors
Constructor must accept the dependencies BotFactory can inject:
Implement profile persistence hooks if state is durable:
- use repository for artifacts instead of open-coded paths
Expose inference-only helpers used by VisualizationWindow:
Do not update durable learning state or write artifacts here
VisualizationFrame will still load the profile,
but report panels do nothing unless a strategy or graceful fallback exists
adds the type to the runtime registry
-> BotFactory.createBot() when the type is registered
Only numeric config params and rewards?
No custom profile control rendering required;
current code otherwise falls back to QLearningConfig
instead of falling back to QLearningConfig
and/or services/training.py only if maze source,
threading, pause, or stop semantics change
